newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Alliance buys baby goods firm,says in talks.
newsitem.headline: Alliance buys baby goods firm,says in talks.

text.p: Alliance Pharmaceuticals said on Wednesday it had bought the business of Whitehall International Marketing, a distributor of Baby Club products, with effect from December 31, 1996.
No purchase price was given but Alliance said that the acquisition would broaden the range of products it supplies to the managed health care industry.
It said the purchase would not immediately affect earnings but it was expected to contribute in the medium term to the earnings of both Alliance and its listed holding company Forim Holdings Ltd.
Alliance said it was in talks concerning additional transactions and shareholders of both companies were advised to exercise caution when dealing in the firms' shares.
